recent: Al-'Aqar Healthcare REIT 近期完成了以 RM12.00 million 出售位于 Penang 的 KPJ Healthcare College 物业，并宣布了 2026 财年第二次中期收入分配（每单位 1.76 sen）。此外，公司已向证券监督委员会提交了总额 RM3 billion 的 sukuk 计划。

recent_en: Al-'Aqar Healthcare REIT recently completed the disposal of its KPJ Healthcare College property in Penang for RM12.00 million and declared a second interim income distribution of 1.76 sen per unit for FY2026. The company also lodged sukuk programmes with a combined limit of RM3 billion with the Securities Commission.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of KPJ Healthcare College property in Penang for RM12.00 million.
Declared a second interim income distribution of 1.76 sen per unit for FY2026.
Lodged sukuk programmes with a combined limit of RM3 billion with the Securities Commission.
earnings_en: 2Q2026 revenue was RM32.97 million, up 14.3% year-on-year, while net income fell 1.0% year-on-year to RM15.80 million, with net margin declining to 47.9% from 52.5% in the previous quarter.
